scope: Post-failure, matched computational experiment: rotate all fixed-scale Gaussian lap controls by the data-only prior-whitened design eigenbasis. Keep every direction and the original prior/likelihood. Original generator, observations, truths, studies, seeds, sampler settings, gates and retries are unchanged. This is neither independent model evidence nor a change to the original failed profile.
stopping: Process the whole original inventory. Only the existing fixed retry ladder is allowed. Preserve all attempts, including failures. Do not search rotations, adjust settings, redraw truths, select an earlier failed attempt or use this profile for publication.

acceptance.criterion: Report every matched study under the unchanged diagnostics; this experiment does not complete recovery, SBC or predictive validation.
